openQuestions.title: Handle the suspended-context path in the probe
openQuestions.detail: When the AudioContext cannot reach 'running' (no user activation, autoplay-blocked, headless), the probe hangs at 'running…' indefinitely with empty metrics. Await ctx.resume(), time out after a few seconds, and report 'context suspended — click again / audio blocked' so the probe can never silently stall. A real user click usually carries activation, so this is a robustness gap rather than a broken user path.
